title: Cobblemon Megadex Modpack
description: Cobblemon Megadex is a modpack that expands the core Cobblemon 1.7 experience.
body:
Cobblemon Megadex is a modpack that expands the core Cobblemon 1.7 experience. No NPC trainers, no crazy world generation, no increased survival difficulty. Just a bunch of additions inspired from the mainline Pokémon games and a few quality of life changes to make the experience worth playing during your 2 week Minecraft phase.

![Added missing Pokémon models](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dee1d739359aaa24899dd252c2f2051cc4ca64b9_0.webp)

This modpack uses AllTheMons to add most of the missing Pokémon from the base mod with a little bit of CompleteCobblemonCollection to finish what the first datapack doesn’t have. Every Pokémon is available either in the wild, inside structures, or via other events that will be mentioned below.

![Mega Showdown and Navas ZA Megas are present](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fa368366a6f511f8b40ff03fb87b9fb598c22261_0.webp)

Mega Showdown is one of the 3 big addons this modpack is centered around, you can use every modern mechanic, and with the extra addition of Navas ZA Megas you can even use the Mega Evolutions from Pokémon Legends ZA!

![Legendary Monuments is here](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/98b7a212c999352cc01c6f0ecd95aca503a85d66_0.webp)

Legendary Structures is also there to give you a reason to explore the world, with an immersive way to obtain the most powerful Pokémons available in the franchise.

![Raid Dens with unique interiors](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/818116e1d3af966105d6724459f1f29cf0346e2e_0.webp)

Raid Dens is the last big addition to this modpack, fight against strong Pokémon variants either in solo or with your friends and get rare Pokémons (including legendary Pokémons that aren’t available in other ways) as well as strong and rare loot.

![Cobblemon Quality of Life](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ab9462987aa35d07d08abb8783ba4b2487120cb9_0.webp)

There are a bunch of smaller Cobblemon additions that made their ways into this pack, including TMs and TRs, breeding Pokémons, a Pokénav, and much more.

![Minecraft Quality of Life](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5d1ee7e2c1bb0670215b6e08c2e29eedb98f9c09_0.webp)

There isn't just quality of life to the Cobblemon side of things, but also the regular Minecraft experience. A bunch of optimization mods, backpacks to store the immense amount of loot this modpack gives you, waystones to travel to points of interest or between your friends’ bases, gravestones to contain your inventory if you were to die, a world map to make exploration easier, the list goes on.

![Also fun in multiplayer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a6a2dca1d31dca30a390c04b44a6037e17685c6b_0.webp)

Multiplayer isn’t left to the side, regular loot chests are replaced with Lootr chests so everyone on your server can obtain loots from all the new structures this modpack has, and there’s even custom craftable badges in case you wanna roleplay as Gym Leaders with your friends.

If you enjoy this modpack don’t hesitate to share it to people you know. This is a simple passion project of mine and white it isn’t the craziest thing in the world, I'm proud of this project and I hope you’re having as much fun playing as I had making it.

Version 2.0 was the final vision I have for this modpack, as Cobblemon version 1.8 is around the corner when Megadex 2.0 is released, the only update to this modpack will be bugfixes and changes based on new content Pokémon Champions releases.
